profile.reading: This facility is attributed in the registry to NTT, part of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation, one of the largest telecommunications and IT services groups in the world, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. NTT operates a global data center business, NTT Global Data Centers, under NTT DATA, Inc. The operators own about us page, fetched this session, states NTT DATA is a top 10 global IT services provider with about 30 billion dollars in annual revenue, operations across 33 countries, and about 3 billion dollars in annual research and development investment, headquartered at the Toyosu Center Building, 3-3-3 Toyosu, Koto-ku, Tokyo 135-6033, Japan, though these figures describe the wider NTT DATA organization rather than the data center division specifically, and no data center division formation or acquisition date was found on the pages fetched this session. A previously confirmed, specific data center acquisition remains NTT Communications purchase of an 86.7 percent stake in e-shelter, described as Germany top data center operator, completed around June 23, 2015, though that acquisition is not directly connected to this United States facility. This session reached the operators own services.global.ntt data center locations pages directly and successfully. An earlier sessions attempts to reach the ragingwire.com domain had failed and found no corresponding Wikipedia article, a negative finding this session did not need to repeat. The operators own current Sacramento area locations page, fetched this session, confirms an active, named 52.7 MW Sacramento data center campus with 266,000 square feet of total data floor space across three numbered buildings, CA1, CA2, and CA3, but gives no per building street addresses. A dedicated CA2 facility page, guessed from the naming pattern used successfully elsewhere for this operator, returned 404. Reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a third party service returned 1312 Striker Ave, Sacramento, CA 95834 at 0.9 confidence and a tight 0.014 distance, on an industrial feeling street name consistent with the areas known airport adjacent business park character. Given the operators own confirmation of a real, named, active data center campus in this immediate area, corroborating a tight, high confidence reverse geocode of this rows own coordinates, this session applies this address, noting the operator itself did not publish a per building street address.
